newsitem.title: UK: London freight - Nothing seen to allay owner fears.
newsitem.headline: London freight - Nothing seen to allay owner fears.

text.p: Owners' fears of an early summer freight market decline were scarcely allayed by latest developments when, in a notably quiet end to the week, brokers reported a deteriorating situation worldwide for Capers.

The Panamax market in the East was described by one owner's broker as 'unravelling' and others were pessimistic about prospects for these types in the Atlantic. Lack of news about Handy-size activity in all areas was also discouraging for owners. The BFI fell 14 points (for the second time this week) to 1467, making a loss of 46 points since Easter.

Reports from Tokyo indicated that Finagrain had fixed 54,000 heavy grain Plate and Bahia Blanca or Necochea/Japan for 20/30 April at $29.50 no combo basis 2-1 but were denied by charterers. Tokyo also reported that Hanjin fixed 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Japan for 13/23 April at a weaker $24.85 no combo (possibly NSAC tonnage). There were rumours that Pan Ocean booked Andre tonnage for 7/14 April at $24.50 no combo. Pan Ocean or Halla were linked with the Seatrans-relet Sumava 71,000 dwt - said to have missed her cancelling date in the US Gulf for a trip to the Far East with Pan Ocean at $15,500 daily plus $325,000 bonus.

The vessel was variously rumoured refixed for the same trip for as little as $14,500 daily plus a bonus of $250,000 or 280,000. There was some more constructive news for owners with a number of orders quoted from S America. Toepfer have 50,000 heavy grain Plate to Thailand option Indonesia or Malaysia for any April, Progress 60/80,000 dwt delivery S Bazil 20/30 Aril for 2-4 months redelivery Alantic, Cargill 2.3/2.8m cft grain Paranagua or Santos/UK-Continent option Spanish Med 10/18 April, Interbulk 38/48,000 grains 54' Paranagua to Lisbon-Hamburg range for 21/30 April, Continental 1.2m cft grain Rio Grande/E Med-Poland range for prompt loading, and Sunwoo require a vessel of about 1.7m cft grain delivery Bahia Blanca April/May for a trip to Japan of S Korea with wheat. elsewhere Saroc quoted 1.1/1.4m cft grain Mississippi/2 ports Italy for 10/20 April.
There were few grounds for optimism for owners following the latest Caper fixture reports. a number of vessels were covered
